The Intune Management Extension service will be restarted in the background. Try again in a few minutes.

The support needs the logs of your device to analyze an issue, for example a failed app installation, a failed setup or an error message. This action collects all relevant logs and system information with administrator rights through the local SelfX service and opens a new e-mail to the support with the report attached. Nothing is sent automatically.

SelfX now collects the logs of your device. This can take several minutes. Nothing on your device is changed.
The report contains the name of your device and your user name. When it is ready, a new e-mail with the report attached opens. Describe your issue and send the e-mail to the support.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with Teams
Action.Explanation: You are experiencing an issue with the Teams client (slowness, incorrect status, transfer error, etc.).
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Teams will close and its local cache folders will be cleared. Save any open work before continuing. Teams will reopen if it was running.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with Word
Action.Explanation: You are working in Word, but it has stopped responding and you can no longer do anything.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Word will close and start again. Documents are not reopened automatically. Unsaved work is lost.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with Excel
Action.Explanation: You are working in Excel, but it has stopped responding and you can no longer do anything.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Excel will close and start again. Workbooks are not reopened automatically. Unsaved work is lost.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with Outlook
Action.Explanation: You are working in Outlook, but it has stopped responding, no longer sends or receives mail or does not display your mailbox correctly.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Outlook will close and start again. Mails you are writing that are not saved as a draft are lost. After the start Outlook may need some time to check its data. Your profile and mailbox are not changed. The new Outlook is not affected.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with the Microsoft Store
Action.Explanation: You have issues with the Microsoft Store (opening the Store, installing apps, etc.).
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The Microsoft Store cache will be reset and the Store will open.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with OneDrive (method 1)
Action.Explanation: You are experiencing issues with the OneDrive client (file or folder synchronization, opening files, etc.).
Action.Alerte_MSG:
OneDrive will close and reopen automatically.
If the issue persists, use method 2.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Solve an issue with OneDrive (method 2)
Action.Explanation: You are experiencing issues with the OneDrive client (file or folder synchronization, opening files, etc.) and have already tried method 1.

Action.Name: The "Teams meeting" button is missing in Outlook
Action.Explanation: The "New Teams meeting" button is missing in Outlook.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The Teams meeting add-in will be enabled again. Outlook will close and reopen automatically. Unsaved work may be lost.
If the issue persists, please contact your support.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: You have connection issues on your device
Action.Explanation: You are trying to open a website, but the connection does not work, the site cannot be reached or you get errors.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The DNS cache of your device will be cleared in the background. Try again after clicking OK.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Your device is running slow
Action.Explanation: Your device is running slow.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Temporary files and the content of the recycle bin will be deleted.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: The time of your device is wrong
Action.Explanation: Sign-in or certificate errors occur, or the clock of your device shows the wrong time. This action runs with administrator rights through the local SelfX service.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The clock of your device will be synchronized with the time source of your organization. The time zone is not changed. Try again after clicking OK.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Restart the Intune service
Restart the network adapters
Action.Explanation: You have network issues and want to restart the network adapters. This action runs with administrator rights through the local SelfX service.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
All network adapters will be restarted. Network access will be interrupted for a short time.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Repair a locked OneDrive file
Send the device logs to the support
Google Chrome: delete browsing data
Action.Explanation: Websites do not load or display correctly in Google Chrome. The action deletes saved browsing data of the default profile.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Google Chrome will close immediately; unsaved input on websites is lost. In the default profile the cache, cookies, history, visited links, top sites and saved form data (autofill) are deleted. You will be signed out of many websites. Bookmarks and saved passwords are kept. Other Chrome profiles are not affected.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Microsoft Edge: clear the cache
Action.Explanation: Websites do not load or display correctly in Microsoft Edge. The action clears the cache of the default profile only.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Microsoft Edge will close immediately; unsaved input on websites is lost. Then the cache of the default profile is cleared. Cookies, history, saved passwords, bookmarks and other profiles are not affected, so you stay signed in to websites.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Firefox: delete browsing data
Action.Explanation: Websites do not load or display correctly in Firefox. The action deletes saved browsing data of all Firefox profiles.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Firefox will close immediately; unsaved input on websites is lost. In all profiles the cache, cookies and stored website data are deleted. You will be signed out of many websites. Bookmarks and saved passwords are kept.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: The "Teams meeting" button is missing in Outlook
Action.Explanation: The "New Teams meeting" button is missing in Outlook.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Outlook will close and then open again automatically. Unsaved work may be lost.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Outlook suggests wrong or outdated e-mail addresses
Action.Explanation: When you type a name in a new e-mail, Outlook suggests addresses that are wrong, no longer exist or belong to another person.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The list of suggested e-mail addresses (auto-complete list) of Outlook will be cleared. Outlook will close and start again. Mails you are writing that are not saved as a draft may be lost. Outlook builds the list again while you send new mails. Your mailbox, contacts and profile are not changed. The new Outlook is not affected.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Excel opens every file in the same window
Action.Explanation: You want to compare two workbooks side by side, for example on two screens, but Excel always opens the second file in the same window.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
A second, independent Excel window will be started. Excel windows and workbooks that are already open are not closed or changed.
Open the second workbook in the new window (File > Open) and move the window to your other screen. Files that you open by double-click may still open in the first window.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Office asks to activate or reports an unlicensed product
Action.Explanation: Word, Excel, Outlook or another Office app shows "Unlicensed Product", asks again and again to activate or to sign in, or says that your account does not have a license although it has one.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
All open Office apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Access, OneNote, Publisher, Visio, Project, Skype for Business) will close. Unsaved work is lost. Then the saved license data of your user account is removed. Your documents, settings, mailbox and Office program files are not changed. Teams is not closed.
The next time you start an Office app, you are asked to sign in with your work account. Office then gets a new license.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Start the OneDrive client
Action.Explanation: OneDrive is not running.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Your OneDrive client will be started.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Restart the OneDrive client
Action.Explanation: Restarting OneDrive can solve some issues, for example synchronization issues.

Action.Name: Solve OneDrive synchronization issues (step 1)
Action.Explanation:
You have synchronization issues with your files or folders in OneDrive.
This first step restarts OneDrive. OneDrive will close and then open again automatically.
If the issue persists, run the action "Reset the OneDrive client".

Action.Name: OneDrive does not start: error 0x8004def4
Action.Explanation: The error 0x8004def4 is displayed when OneDrive starts.

Action.Name: Your device is slow: OneDrive uses a lot of memory
Action.Explanation: Your device is running slow and OneDrive seems to use a lot of memory.

Action.Name: Red cross on the OneDrive icon
Action.Explanation: A red cross is displayed on the OneDrive icon.

Action.Name: OneDrive closes by itself
Action.Explanation: OneDrive opens and then closes again by itself.

Action.Name: White cross on OneDrive files
Action.Explanation: A white cross is displayed on OneDrive files or folders.

Action.Name: Issues with OneDrive after changing the Windows password
Action.Explanation:
You changed your password recently and now you have issues with OneDrive, for example synchronization issues.
This step restarts the OneDrive client.

Action.Name: You cannot open files in OneDrive
Action.Explanation: Files stored in OneDrive do not open.

Action.Name: Folders synchronize in OneDrive but not in Teams
Reset the OneDrive client
Action.Explanation:
You have issues with OneDrive, for example synchronization issues.
This step resets your OneDrive client. Resetting the OneDrive client does not cause any data loss.

Action.Name: Solve Teams connection issues
Action.Explanation: You cannot connect to Teams.

Action.Name: Solve Teams profile picture synchronization
Action.Explanation: Your profile picture is not displayed in Teams or is not updated.

Action.Name: Folders synchronize in OneDrive but not in Teams
Teams is stuck on "Loading Microsoft Teams"
Action.Explanation: When you open Teams, the window is stuck on "Loading Microsoft Teams".

Action.Name: Solve Teams synchronization issues
Action.Explanation: You have synchronization issues in Teams.

Action.Name: My Teams client does not open
Action.Explanation: You try to open Teams, but the client does not open.

Action.Name: My Teams client freezes during audio calls
Action.Explanation: Teams freezes during an audio call.

Action.Name: The Teams camera is frozen or not visible
Action.Explanation: Your video is frozen or not visible during a meeting or call.

Action.Name: Teams messages cannot be sent
Action.Explanation: Messages in Teams are not sent and Teams shows "Failed to send".

Action.Name: Display issues when joining a Teams meeting
Action.Explanation: Teams does not display correctly when you join a meeting.

Action.Name: My Teams client opens but does not connect
Action.Explanation: Teams opens, but it does not connect.

Action.Name: My Teams status stays offline
Action.Explanation: Your status in Teams stays "Offline" although you are signed in.

Action.Name: The Teams call window is not displayed
Action.Explanation: Notifications of incoming Teams calls are no longer displayed.

Action.Name: I cannot see the content of a message in Teams
Action.Explanation: You see the message notification and preview, but not the content of the message.

Action.Name: Connection issues after changing the password
Action.Explanation: You cannot connect to Teams after changing your password.

Action.Name: Tabs in Teams do not load
Action.Explanation: When you open tabs in Teams, they do not load correctly.

Action.Name: My Teams status is not correct
Action.Explanation: Your status in Teams is not correct or is not updated.

Action.Name: I cannot open a Teams meeting
Action.Explanation: Teams meetings do not open when you click the link to join.

Action.Name: Sound cuts out during Teams meetings
Action.Explanation: The sound cuts out during Teams meetings.

Action.Name: I cannot create a Teams meeting in the Outlook calendar
Action.Explanation: You cannot create a Teams meeting from the Outlook calendar.

Action.Name: Force an Intune synchronization
Check the disk for OneDrive errors (chkdsk)
The tag present in the reparse point buffer is invalid
Error 0x80071129
Check this PC for viruses (Microsoft Defender quick scan)
Action.Explanation: You suspect a virus, a suspicious file was opened or Windows Security shows a warning. The action runs a quick scan with Microsoft Defender and tells you at the end whether it found threats.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
A quick scan with Microsoft Defender starts. It checks the places where threats are found most often and usually takes 5 to 30 minutes. You can keep working, but the PC may be slower meanwhile. SelfX shows the result when the scan has finished.
SelfX does not delete or change any files. If Defender finds a threat, it handles it as set by your company; you find the details in Windows Security.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Refresh the company settings (Group Policy) of this PC
Action.Explanation: Settings of your company, such as network drives, printers or security rules, do not arrive or are out of date. The action asks Windows to apply the group policies again. It only works on devices that are joined to a domain (also hybrid joined devices).
Action.Alerte_MSG:
Windows checks and applies the group policies of your company again. This can take a few minutes. You are not signed out and Windows does not restart; a setting that needs a restart or a new sign-in takes effect after the next one. If your device is not joined to a domain, the action ends with the exit code 3 and changes nothing.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: No sound on this PC
Action.Explanation: There is no sound from the speakers or headphones, although everything was fine before. The sound may be switched off (muted) or turned down very low.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
SelfX switches the sound of your current playback device (speakers or headphones) on again. If it is muted, the sound is switched on; if the volume is below 30 %, it is raised to 30 %. A higher volume stays as it is. Other devices, the microphone and drivers are not changed.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Collect the device logs and send them to the support by e-mail
Forgot or expired password: reset it yourself
Action.Explanation: You forgot your password, it has expired or your account is locked. You can set a new password yourself on the sign-in page of your company account, without calling the support.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The page to reset your password opens in your web browser. Sign in with your work e-mail address and follow the steps. You may be asked to confirm your identity, for example with your phone or the authenticator app. SelfX does not see or save your password.
Do you want to continue?

Action.Name: Manage the sign-in methods of your account (security info)
Action.Explanation: You have a new phone, lost your authenticator app or want to change the phone number or sign-in method of your company account.
Action.Alerte_MSG:
The security info page of your account opens in your web browser. Sign in with your work account to add, change or remove sign-in methods such as the authenticator app or your phone number. SelfX does not see or save your data.
Do you want to continue?
